close_reason: MemoryError is test-only, not public API; String wrapping acceptable in test code.
description: tests/common/mod.rs MemoryError(pub String) is a stringly-typed error. Callers (handler tests) can only match on the error by inspecting the string message, not by variant. Even for test code, using thiserror enum variants (SerializeError(serde_json::Error), DeserializeError{type_name: &'static str, source: serde_json::Error}) makes assertion failures self-explanatory and enables matching in tests that want to assert specific error conditions.
title: MemoryError wraps String instead of using thiserror
